mapper.sql: CHECK_KEY, INSTITUTION_ID, BATCH_ID, CHECK_ID, CHECKED_AT, SOURCE_KIND, SOURCE_SLUG, STATUS_CD, ERROR_CD, MATCH_CONF, MATCH_BASIS, TITLE, ITEM_NO, PUBLISHER, POSTED_AT, DEADLINE_AT, SRC_URL, IMPORTED_AT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXT_CHECK_FILE (CHECK_KEY, FILE_SEQ, FORMAT_CD, STORED_NAME, SHA256, FILE_SIZE) VALUES (#{checkKey}, #{fileSeq}, #{formatCd}, #{storedName}, #{sha256}, #{fileSize})
INSERT INTO EXT_CHECK_EXCL (BATCH_ID, CHECK_ID, FILE_SEQ, REASON_CD, LOCATOR_CD, HIT_CNT, EXCLUDED_AT) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{checkId}, #{fileSeq}, #{reasonCd}, #{locatorCd}, #{hitCnt}, #{excludedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EXT_CHECK WHERE BATCH_ID = #{batchId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EXT_CHECK_EXCL WHERE BATCH_ID = #{batchId}
